mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5pp over 3 months, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and compress S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 100,000 jobs per month for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth slows by > 100k jobs/mo for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth slows by > 100k jobs/mo for 2 consecutive months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth accelerates by more than 20% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening housing market and consumer spending that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y HOUST growth > 20% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth decelerates by more than 2% year-over-year, it signals a weakening manufacturing sector and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y INDPRO growth decelerates by > 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate and the consumer price index (CPI) are both rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy and rising inflation that will compress S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rising but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth and housing starts growth are both accelerating, it signals a strengthening economy and consumer spending that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and HOUST both accelerating but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.
